steps.title: Video: the modal verb müssen
steps.note: 0:26 a famous quote · 1:42 *müssen* = *have to* · 2:13 conjugation · 2:45 four situations (necessity, rule, order, duty) · 5:26 *müssen* without a second verb · 6:38 bonus: *nicht brauchen zu* · 7:48 homework.

steps.title: müssen
steps.note: Like *können*: no ending with *ich* and *er*, and no umlaut in the singular. Same sentence structure: *müssen* in position 2, the other verb **at the end**.

steps.title: Careful: „nicht müssen“ ≠ „must not“
steps.md:
Translate *müssen* as **have to**:

- {de:Ich muss arbeiten.} = I have to work.
- {de:Ich muss nicht arbeiten.} = I **don't have to** work (I'm free!) — **not** *I must not work*.

A nice alternative: {de:Ich brauche nicht zu arbeiten.}

When it's obvious, the second verb can go: {de:Ich muss nach Hause.} (= go home)
